description: Use command-line, versioning, testing, and development tools.

description: Select and reason about linear and non-linear data structures.

description: Analyze and design algorithms using established paradigms.

description: Reason about formal languages, automata, and computability.

description: Explain processes, concurrency, memory, and persistence.

description: Describe the phases and intermediate representations of compilation.

name: Database systems
description: Model, query, and normalize relational data.

name: Artificial intelligence
description: Apply search, representation, reasoning, and learning concepts.

name: Communication
